notes.title: ❗❗New release Date ❗❗
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, MMM Dev-Team here!

It’s been a while since the last announcement, as we were busy working hard on developing our game. In the last few months we made a ton of progress bringing The Maritime Mecha Mystery to life, but also faced a few challenges along the way. We are a small Indie Studio working on our first game and while the learning curve is steep we have to respect our own limitations. So with a heavy heart we decided to postpone the release of MMM for a couple of months. This is a necessary step to ensure that The Maritime Mecha Mystery provides our future players with all the fun and excitement they deserve. 

We aim to release our game in August this year but will officially announce the exact release Date once it is decided. Until then we want to thank everyone who supported us on our journey so far! We cannot wait to welcome you all to Lord Aegir’s Mechanical Mansion! 💙

In the meantime, you can follow our social media channels for more MMM content!

notes.title: ❗⌛❗Only 24h left before our kickstarter ends!! ❗⌛❗
notes.notes:
The final 24 hours of our kickstarter campaign have officially started! 😱 A campaign full of excitement, valuable lessons and hard work is coming to an end and we once again want to thank everyone for their support! You made this campaign a success and we are eternally grateful to everyone who believes in us and our project! 💖

But even if the end is near, there are still 24 hours to go. Let’s make this a finale worth remembering! If you were thinking about grabbing one of our amazing kickstarter exclusive rewards, do it now! The time is running out and once the campaign is over, they are gone forever! 👋

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ornhammergames/maritime-mecha-mystery-an-investigative-visual-novel-game]LAST CHANCE[/url]

This is also the last chance to help us unlock extra content via our stretchgoals. We are close to unlocking Skadi, the daring huntress, but there are even more gods waiting to join the party! 💌
